prompt: Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Use Marine and Coral: page #F7FCFF, text #113C50, accent #B73545, secondary surface #E5F3F8, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Bagnard and reading text in Cotham Sans; characterful display serif with understated body. Composition: Narrow index beside an unframed detail pane; index becomes a menu on mobile. Use body 20px, heading 64px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 60ch, gap 32px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
